items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I'd go down to Baron's to hear -- there was a girl there, I think her name was Hannah Sylvester. ... I'd go in there to hear Hannah Sylvester sing, too, because I'm still crazy about her singing.
